players.product: OSAT (incl. JCET STATS ChipPAC Korea) - package substrate buyer from Simmtech and Daeduck Electronics

quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 results (quarterly report): Q3 revenue RMB 11,425,106,255.72, up 13.53% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 772,691,876.23, up 59.99%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 752,550,804.84, up 117.43%. First nine months of 2026: revenue RMB 30,952,329,578.85, up 7.96%; total profit RMB 1,738,888,321.54, up 47.20%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 1,617,336,151.27, up 69.58%; excluding non-recurring items RMB 1,560,885,001.00, up 99.17%; operating cash flow RMB 4,299,927,196.79, up 16.44%. Gross margin for the first nine months rose 2.3 percentage points YoY.
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 2026 revenue RMB 11,425,106,255.72 (+13.53% YoY); net profit attributable RMB 772,691,876.23 (+59.99%)

quarterly_data.signal: Demand and utilisation (quarterly report): the company attributes Q3 growth to rapidly growing demand tied to AI infrastructure and edge devices, a clear domestic semiconductor substitution trend and a continuing improvement in the global semiconductor cycle; customer orders kept growing and capacity utilisation ran at a high level while it accelerated capacity expansion; high-value-added products increased, and operating scale and profitability grew quarter by quarter through the first nine months.
Revenue mix (quarterly report): in the first nine months of 2026 computing electronics was 30.9% of revenue, up 54% YoY, and automotive electronics 11.3%, up 30% YoY.
quarterly_data.figure: computing electronics 30.9% of 9M 2026 revenue (+54% YoY); automotive electronics 11.3% (+30%)

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity investment (quarterly report): cash paid for fixed and other long-term assets RMB 8,890,899,361.11 in the first nine months of 2026 versus RMB 4,357,142,425.44 a year earlier; construction in progress RMB 6,944,615,769.50 at September 30, 2026 versus RMB 3,894,315,261.29 at end-2025; inventory RMB 6,158,484,869.31 versus RMB 3,810,987,995.81; R&D expense RMB 1,596,268,729.50 in the first nine months versus RMB 1,536,492,910.68.
quarterly_data.figure: 9M 2026 cash capex RMB 8,890,899,361.11; construction in progress RMB 6,944,615,769.50 at 09-30-2026

quarterly_data.signal: Planned capacity programs (quarterly report): on September 3, 2026 the board approved a private A-share placement; the funds are intended for expanding the high-performance-computing high-end advanced packaging platform, upgrading high-end power-module advanced packaging-and-test capacity, upgrading and expanding the wafer-level packaging advanced process platform, and upgrading high-density large-capacity memory chip system-level packaging-and-test capability. The plan has state-owned-asset approval in principle but still needs shareholder approval, SSE review and CSRC registration, so these programs are conditional.
